description: React component implementing a table for t-test statistical analysis, including computation of lift and p-values, and rendering a sortable table with significance indicators.

classes.name: TTestTable
classes.description: React component class for displaying t-test results in a table with interactive features.

methods.name: getLiftStatus
methods.description: Returns CSS class based on lift value for styling.

methods.name: getPValueStatus
methods.description: Returns CSS class based on p-value for styling.

methods.name: getSignificance
methods.description: Determines if p-value indicates statistical significance.

methods.name: computeLift
methods.description: Calculates percentage lift between two data series.

methods.name: computePValue
methods.description: Calculates p-value using Student's t-test for two data series.

methods.name: computeTTest
methods.description: Computes lift and p-values for all data rows against a control.
